title: Ensure Safety
simplified_paragraphs: 去年，弟弟告诉我，他正在种水果。我问他：“种西瓜了吗？”
弟弟：“没，我担心天不下雨。”
我又问：“那你种苹果了吗？”
弟弟：“没，我担心虫子吃了苹果。”
弟弟：“什么也没种，我要确保安全。”
最后，弟弟什么也没收获。
traditional_paragraphs: 去年，弟弟告訴我，他正在種水果。我問他：“種西瓜了嗎？”
弟弟：“沒，我擔心天不下雨。”
我又問：“那你種蘋果了嗎？”
弟弟：“沒，我擔心蟲子吃了蘋果。”
弟弟：“什麼也沒種，我要確保安全。”
最後，弟弟什麼也沒收穫。
pinyin_paragraphs: qù nián， dì di gào su wǒ， tā zhèng zài zhòng shuǐ guǒ。 wǒ wèn tā：“ zhòng xī guā le ma？”
dì di：“ méi， wǒ dān xīn tiān bù xià yǔ。”
wǒ yòu wèn：“ nà nǐ zhòng píng guǒ le ma？”
dì di：“ méi， wǒ dān xīn chóng zi chī le píng guǒ。”
wǒ zài wèn：“ nà nǐ zhòng le shén me？”
dì di：“ shén me yě méi zhòng， wǒ yào què bǎo ān quán。”
zuì hòu， dì di shén me yě méi shōu huò。
english_paragraphs: Last year, my younger brother told me he was growing fruit. I asked him, “Did you plant any watermelons?”
He said, “No, I was worried it wouldn’t rain.”
I asked, “Then did you plant any apple trees?”
He said, “No, I was worried bugs would eat the apples.”
I asked again, “So what did you plant?”
He said, “Nothing. I wanted to play it safe.”
In the end, my younger brother harvested nothing.
english_full:
Last year, my younger brother told me he was growing fruit. I asked him, “Did you plant any watermelons?”

He said, “No, I was worried it wouldn’t rain.”

I asked, “Then did you plant any apple trees?”

He said, “No, I was worried bugs would eat the apples.”

I asked again, “So what did you plant?”

He said, “Nothing. I wanted to play it safe.”

In the end, my younger brother harvested nothing.
